verdict.rationale: Supabase exposes a Management API for programmatic project/org control, a REST/GraphQL API auto-generated from the schema, an official CLI, and MCP server/agent-skills for AI-driven database, migration, and function management — covering most core operations achievable via the Dashboard UI. However, some Dashboard-only surfaces (Advisors, Logs viewer, AI Assistant, certain platform settings/backups management) are not clearly exposed as equivalent API/MCP operations, and community evidence shows the CLI/migration flow is considered clunkier than dashboard-driven workflows, with even Supabase's CEO discouraging dashboard edits in favor of migrations — implying gaps in parity rather than a fully symmetric API/UI experience. missing for 10: API/MCP parity evidence for Advisors, Logs, AI Assistant, and backup management; independent confirmation that all dashboard actions have scriptable equivalents.
